reason: The recipe named its author's home directory (/home/swank), so every other site had to edit and commit config/cluster.json before its first start. It now names $HOME, which each site resolves to the home directory of the user its nodes run as.
qualification: Site location only: host.home fills the {home} placeholder of the checkout and mount paths. On the site that qualified spark-ds41f-1120 it resolves to the released value, so the rendered commands, the image and every serve argument are unchanged. Frozen release recipes, baseline manifests and benchmark suites retain their original value.
